content: Human-labeling session — combat-formation-tank-wedge:hard seed 1. Objective: Commander, this is a combat push from two staging bands. You are given 10 medium tanks (Return-Fire orders) split between far north (y=10..14) and far south (y=26..30) on the west edge — read your actual starting band from the observation. A dense bracket guards the corridor: 4 rocket soldiers above at (21..24, 16) and 4 below at (21..24, 24) on Defend orders, with TWO on-axis light tank blockers at (25, 20) and (27, 20) on Return-Fire orders. Land at least 3 tanks at the (46, 20) rally disc while killing at least 4 enemies, within 4500 ticks, keeping at least 3 tanks alive.
